title: Multiscale coupled electron–ion transport in semi-solid lithium flow batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,5868-5896
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00569H, Review Article
Shanshan Pan, Wenhao Fang, Jie Yan, Suojiang Zhang, Haitao Zhang
This review provides in-depth understanding of multiscale electron–ion transport in semi-solid LFBs, outlining mechanisms, optimized strategies, multi-physics field modelling, and future directions to bridge fundamental with commercialization.
